mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_task( biz_type, biz_id, region, machine_result, status, auditor_id, remark ) VALUES ( #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{region}, #{machineResult}, #{status}, #{auditorId}, #{remark} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM audit_log l LEFT JOIN admin_user au ON au.id = l.admin_id

SELECT l.id, l.admin_id, COALESCE(au.account, '') AS admin_account, COALESCE(au.name, '') AS admin_name, l.action, l.target, l.detail, l.ip, l.created_at FROM audit_log l LEFT JOIN admin_user au ON au.id = l.admin_id
ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

merchant_shop_change sc ON sc.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 5 LEFT JOIN merchant_review_appeal ra ON ra.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 6 LEFT JOIN user_expert_certification uc ON uc.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 8 LEFT JOIN merchant_verification mv ON mv.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 9 LEFT JOIN merchant mvm ON mvm.id = mv.merchant_id AND t.biz_type = 9 LEFT JOIN review_comment rc ON rc.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 10 LEFT JOIN review cr ON cr.id = rc.review_id AND t.biz_type = 10 LEFT JOIN post_comment pc ON pc.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 11 LEFT JOIN post cp ON cp.id = pc.post_id AND t.biz_type = 11 LEFT JOIN shop_question sq ON sq.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 12 LEFT JOIN shop_answer sa ON sa.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 13 LEFT JOIN shop_question aq ON aq.id = sa.question_id AND t.biz_type = 13 LEFT JOIN app_user squ ON squ.id = sq.user_id AND t.biz_type = 12 LEFT JOIN app_user sua ON sua.id = sa.user_id AND t.biz_type = 13 LEFT JOIN message msg ON msg.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 14 LEFT JOIN app_user mau ON mau.id = msg.from_user_id AND t.biz_type = 14 LEFT JOIN review ar ON ar.id = ra.review_id AND t.biz_type = 6 LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id = CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 6 THEN ra.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sc.target_shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 4 THEN p.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 2 THEN d.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 10 THEN cr.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 11 THEN cp.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 12 THEN sq.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 13 THEN aq.shop_id ELSE r.shop_id END LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchant sm ON sm.id = sc.merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchant ram ON ram.id = ra.merchant_id LEFT JOIN admin_user claim_admin ON claim_admin.id = t.claimed_by_admin_id
mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.biz_type, t.biz_id, t.region, t.machine_result, t.status, t.auditor_id, t.claimed_by_admin_id, claim_admin.name AS claimed_by_admin_name, t.claimed_at, t.claim_expires_at, t.remark, CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 9 THEN NULL WHEN t.biz_type = 8 THEN NULL WHEN t.biz_type = 7 THEN NULL WHEN t.biz_type = 6 THEN ra.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sc.target_shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 4 THEN p.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 2 THEN d.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 10 THEN cr.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 11 THEN cp.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 12 THEN sq.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 13 THEN aq.shop_id ELSE r.shop_id END AS shop_id, CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 9 THEN '' WHEN t.biz_type = 8 THEN '' WHEN t.biz_type = 7 THEN '' WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sc.name WHEN t.biz_type = 14 THEN '' ELSE s.name END AS shop_name, CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 9 THEN mvm.company_name WHEN t.biz_type = 8 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(bau.nickname, ''), ba.account) WHEN t.biz_type = 7 THEN au.nickname WHEN t.biz_type = 6 THEN ram.company_name WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sm.company_name WHEN t.biz_type = 4 THEN p.user_name WHEN t.biz_type = 2 THEN m.company_name WHEN t.biz_type = 10 THEN rc.user_name WHEN t.biz_type = 11 THEN pc.user_name WHEN t.biz_type = 12 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(squ.nickname, ''), CAST(sq.user_id AS CHAR)) WHEN t.biz_type = 13 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(sua.nickname, ''), CAST(sa.user_id AS CHAR)) WHEN t.biz_type = 14 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(mau.nickname, ''), mau.email, mau.phone) ELSE r.user_name END AS user_name, CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 9 THEN mv.reason WHEN t.biz_type = 8 THEN ba.reason WHEN t.biz_type = 7 THEN uc.reason WHEN t.biz_type = 6 THEN ar.content WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sc.summary WHEN t.biz_type = 4 THEN p.content WHEN t.biz_type = 2 THEN d.title WHEN t.biz_type = 10 THEN rc.content WHEN t.biz_type = 11 THEN pc.content WHEN t.biz_type = 12 THEN sq.content WHEN t.biz_type = 13 THEN sa.content WHEN t.biz_type = 14 THEN msg.content ELSE r.content END AS review_content, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM audit_task t
ORDER BY CASE
WHEN t.biz_type = #{threshold.bizType} AND t.created_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, 0 - CAST(#{threshold.slaMinutes} AS SIGNED), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (t.claimed_by_admin_id IS NULL OR t.claim_expires_at IS NULL OR t.claim_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) THEN 0
ELSE 1 END ASC, t.created_at ASC, t.id ASC
ORDER BY t.id DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.biz_type, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count, MIN(CASE WHEN t.status = 0 THEN t.created_at END) AS oldest_pending_at, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN (1, 2) AND t.auditor_id > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processed_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.status IN (1, 2) AND t.auditor_id > 0 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, t.created_at, t.updated_at) END)) AS average_processing_seconds FROM audit_task t WHERE t.region = #{region} AND t.biz_type IN (10, 11, 12, 13, 14)
AND 1 = 0
AND t.biz_type IN
#{allowedBizType}
GROUP BY t.biz_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_audit_sla_alert( region, biz_type, status, active_key, pending_count, overdue_count, oldest_pending_at, first_overdue_at, last_detected_at ) VALUES ( #{region}, #{bizType}, 0, CONCAT(#{region}, ':', #{bizType}), #{pendingCount}, #{overdueCount}, #{oldestPendingAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pending_count = VALUES(pending_count), overdue_count = VALUES(overdue_count), oldest_pending_at = VALUES(oldest_pending_at), last_detected_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_audit_sla_alert SET status = 1, active_key = NULL, resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE region = #{region} AND biz_type = #{bizType} AND status = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT id, region, biz_type, status, pending_count, overdue_count, oldest_pending_at, first_overdue_at, last_detected_at, resolved_at, created_at FROM admin_audit_sla_alert
ORDER BY status ASC, first_overdue_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.id, t.biz_type, t.biz_id, t.region, t.machine_result, t.status, t.auditor_id, t.claimed_by_admin_id, claim_admin.name AS claimed_by_admin_name, t.claimed_at, t.claim_expires_at, t.remark, CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 9 THEN NULL WHEN t.biz_type = 8 THEN NULL WHEN t.biz_type = 7 THEN NULL WHEN t.biz_type = 6 THEN ra.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sc.target_shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 4 THEN p.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 2 THEN d.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 10 THEN cr.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 11 THEN cp.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 12 THEN sq.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 13 THEN aq.shop_id ELSE r.shop_id END AS shop_id, CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 9 THEN '' WHEN t.biz_type = 8 THEN '' WHEN t.biz_type = 7 THEN '' WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sc.name WHEN t.biz_type = 14 THEN '' ELSE s.name END AS shop_name, CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 9 THEN mvm.company_name WHEN t.biz_type = 8 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(bau.nickname, ''), ba.account) WHEN t.biz_type = 7 THEN au.nickname WHEN t.biz_type = 6 THEN ram.company_name WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sm.company_name WHEN t.biz_type = 4 THEN p.user_name WHEN t.biz_type = 2 THEN m.company_name WHEN t.biz_type = 10 THEN rc.user_name WHEN t.biz_type = 11 THEN pc.user_name WHEN t.biz_type = 12 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(squ.nickname, ''), CAST(sq.user_id AS CHAR)) WHEN t.biz_type = 13 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(sua.nickname, ''), CAST(sa.user_id AS CHAR)) WHEN t.biz_type = 14 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(mau.nickname, ''), mau.email, mau.phone) ELSE r.user_name END AS user_name, CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 9 THEN mv.reason WHEN t.biz_type = 8 THEN ba.reason WHEN t.biz_type = 7 THEN uc.reason WHEN t.biz_type = 6 THEN ar.content WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sc.summary WHEN t.biz_type = 4 THEN p.content WHEN t.biz_type = 2 THEN d.title WHEN t.biz_type = 10 THEN rc.content WHEN t.biz_type = 11 THEN pc.content WHEN t.biz_type = 12 THEN sq.content WHEN t.biz_type = 13 THEN sa.content WHEN t.biz_type = 14 THEN msg.content ELSE r.content END AS review_content, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM audit_task t LEFT JOIN review r ON r.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 3 LEFT JOIN post p ON p.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 4 LEFT JOIN deal d ON d.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 2 LEFT JOIN merchant_shop_change sc ON sc.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 5 LEFT JOIN merchant_review_appeal ra ON ra.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 6 LEFT JOIN user_expert_certification uc ON uc.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 7 LEFT JOIN app_user au ON au.id = uc.user_id AND t.biz_type = 7 LEFT JOIN user_ban_appeal ba ON ba.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 8 LEFT JOIN app_user bau ON bau.id = ba.user_id AND t.biz_type = 8 LEFT JOIN merchant_verification mv ON mv.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 9 LEFT JOIN merchant mvm ON mvm.id = mv.merchant_id AND t.biz_type = 9 LEFT JOIN review_comment rc ON rc.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 10 LEFT JOIN review cr ON cr.id = rc.review_id AND t.biz_type = 10 LEFT JOIN post_comment pc ON pc.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 11 LEFT JOIN post cp ON cp.id = pc.post_id AND t.biz_type = 11 LEFT JOIN shop_question sq ON sq.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 12 LEFT JOIN shop_answer sa ON sa.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 13 LEFT JOIN shop_question aq ON aq.id = sa.question_id AND t.biz_type = 13 LEFT JOIN app_user squ ON squ.id = sq.user_id AND t.biz_type = 12 LEFT JOIN app_user sua ON sua.id = sa.user_id AND t.biz_type = 13 LEFT JOIN message msg ON msg.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 14 LEFT JOIN app_user mau ON mau.id = msg.from_user_id AND t.biz_type = 14 LEFT JOIN review ar ON ar.id = ra.review_id AND t.biz_type = 6 LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id = CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 6 THEN ra.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sc.target_shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 4 THEN p.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 2 THEN d.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 10 THEN cr.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 11 THEN cp.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 12 THEN sq.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 13 THEN aq.shop_id ELSE r.shop_id END LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchant sm ON sm.id = sc.merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchant ram ON ram.id = ra.merchant_id LEFT JOIN admin_user claim_admin ON claim_admin.id = t.claimed_by_admin_id WHERE t.id = #{taskId}

choose.when: SELECT rc.id,rc.user_id,cr.region,rc.content,rc.review_id AS related_id, reply.user_id AS reply_to_user_id FROM review_comment rc JOIN review cr ON cr.id=rc.review_id LEFT JOIN review_comment reply ON reply.id=rc.reply_to AND reply.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE rc.id=#{bizId} AND rc.status=0 AND rc.is_deleted=FALSE

SELECT pc.id,pc.user_id,cp.region,pc.content,pc.post_id AS related_id, reply.user_id AS reply_to_user_id FROM post_comment pc JOIN post cp ON cp.id=pc.post_id LEFT JOIN post_comment reply ON reply.id=pc.reply_to AND reply.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE pc.id=#{bizId} AND pc.status=0 AND pc.is_deleted=FALSE
SELECT sq.id,sq.user_id,sq.region,sq.content,sq.shop_id AS related_id FROM shop_question sq WHERE sq.id=#{bizId} AND sq.status=0 AND sq.is_deleted=FALSE
SELECT sa.id,sa.user_id,sa.region,sa.content,sa.question_id AS related_id FROM shop_answer sa WHERE sa.id=#{bizId} AND sa.status=0 AND sa.is_deleted=FALSE
SELECT msg.id,msg.from_user_id AS user_id,'GLOBAL' AS region,msg.content,msg.conversation_id AS related_id FROM message msg WHERE msg.id=#{bizId} AND msg.status=0 AND msg.is_deleted=FALSE
UPDATE review_comment SET status=#{status},audit_remark=#{remark},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{bizId} AND status=0 AND is_deleted=FALSE
UPDATE post_comment SET status=#{status},audit_remark=#{remark},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{bizId} AND status=0 AND is_deleted=FALSE
UPDATE shop_question SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{bizId} AND status=0 AND is_deleted=FALSE
UPDATE shop_answer SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{bizId} AND status=0 AND is_deleted=FALSE
UPDATE message SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{bizId} AND status=0 AND is_deleted=FALSE

THEN NULL WHEN t.biz_type = 6 THEN ra.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sc.target_shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 4 THEN p.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 2 THEN d.shop_id ELSE r.shop_id END AS shop_id, CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 8 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(bau.nickname, ''), ba.account) WHEN t.biz_type = 7 THEN au.nickname WHEN t.biz_type = 6 THEN ram.company_name WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sm.company_name WHEN t.biz_type = 4 THEN p.user_name WHEN t.biz_type = 2 THEN m.company_name ELSE r.user_name END AS user_name, CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 9 THEN mv.reason WHEN t.biz_type = 8 THEN ba.reason WHEN t.biz_type = 7 THEN uc.reason WHEN t.biz_type = 6 THEN ar.content WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sc.summary WHEN t.biz_type = 4 THEN p.content WHEN t.biz_type = 2 THEN d.title ELSE r.content END AS review_content, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM audit_task t LEFT JOIN review r ON r.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 3 LEFT JOIN post p ON p.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 4 LEFT JOIN deal d ON d.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 2 LEFT JOIN merchant_shop_change sc ON sc.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 5 LEFT JOIN merchant_review_appeal ra ON ra.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 6 LEFT JOIN user_expert_certification uc ON uc.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 7 LEFT JOIN app_user au ON au.id = uc.user_id AND t.biz_type = 7 LEFT JOIN user_ban_appeal ba ON ba.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 8 LEFT JOIN app_user bau ON bau.id = ba.user_id AND t.biz_type = 8 LEFT JOIN merchant_verification mv ON mv.id = t.biz_id AND t.biz_type = 9 LEFT JOIN merchant mvm ON mvm.id = mv.merchant_id AND t.biz_type = 9 LEFT JOIN review ar ON ar.id = ra.review_id AND t.biz_type = 6 LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id = CASE WHEN t.biz_type = 6 THEN ra.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 5 THEN sc.target_shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 4 THEN p.shop_id WHEN t.biz_type = 2 THEN d.shop_id ELSE r.shop_id END LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchant sm ON sm.id = sc.merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchant ram ON ram.id = ra.merchant_id WHERE t.biz_type = #{bizType} AND t.biz_id = #{bizId} AND t.status = 0 ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_task SET status = 2, auditor_id = 0, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} AND status = 0

UPDATE audit_task SET status=2,auditor_id=0,remark=#{remark},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status=0 AND biz_type=#{bizType} AND biz_id IN
(SELECT id FROM review_comment WHERE id=#{parentId} OR parent_id=#{parentId})
(SELECT id FROM post_comment WHERE id=#{parentId} OR parent_id=#{parentId})

UPDATE audit_task SET status=2,auditor_id=0,remark=#{remark},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status=0 AND biz_type=#{bizType} AND biz_id IN
(SELECT id FROM review_comment WHERE review_id=#{contentId})
(SELECT id FROM post_comment WHERE post_id=#{contentId})
UPDATE audit_task SET status = #{status}, auditor_id = #{auditorId}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 0

UPDATE audit_task SET claimed_at = CASE WHEN claimed_by_admin_id = #{adminId} AND claim_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN claimed_at ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, claimed_by_admin_id = #{adminId}, claim_expires_at = TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, #{leaseMinutes}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 0 AND biz_type IN (10, 11, 12, 13, 14) AND (claimed_by_admin_id IS NULL OR claim_expires_at IS NULL OR claim_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP OR claimed_by_admin_id = #{adminId})

UPDATE audit_task SET claimed_by_admin_id = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 0 AND biz_type IN (10, 11, 12, 13, 14) AND claimed_by_admin_id = #{adminId}

UPDATE audit_task SET status = #{status}, auditor_id = #{adminId}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 0 AND biz_type IN (10, 11, 12, 13, 14) AND claimed_by_admin_id = #{adminId} AND claim_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE deal SET audit_status=#{auditStatus}, reject_reason=#{rejectReason}, status=0, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{dealId} AND region=#{region} AND audit_status=0 AND is_deleted=FALSE
UPDATE post SET audit_status=#{auditStatus}, audit_remark=#{auditRemark}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{postId} AND region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log(admin_id, action, target, detail, ip) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{action}, #{target}, #{detail}, #{ip})
